description: Input plan for concurrent scoring; not an evaluation summary. Results require all 771 prediction files.

protocol.name: native-mask-disparity
protocol.input: RGB float32/255, short side >=518, aspect preserved, multiple14, ImageNet norm
protocol.interpolation: OpenCV cubic input; bilinear align_corners=False prediction
protocol.precision: float32 inference; float64 affine fit and scoring
protocol.evaluation_mask: provided mask > 0, finite mask and depth, depth > 0; full frame
protocol.alignment: per-image least squares scale and shift to reciprocal GT on evaluation mask
protocol.nonpositive_delta1: count as failure; keep GT mask
protocol.aggregation: unweighted mean of per-image metrics; no skipped images
